artboards.title: Why is this the number? — drill-down

annotations.text:
UnifyApps Design System, as published.
Workspace ground is brand-secondary-25 #fbfaf9 (warm sand), not cool gray.
Brand green = identity + CTAs + selected state, never a status band.
Status is glyph + 14px label, no pill: green #39A147 / amber / red #a8503a.
Type: Geist UI · Geist Mono for money and codes · Spectral display.

Every amount carries its currency and an as-of date - the money doctrine in docs/model/money-and-time.md.
Explainability is the product: payout -> earning -> rate band -> credits -> transaction, and the drill-down artboard walks the whole chain.
